review.reviewer: Gauss and Zeno read-only campaign reviewers
findings: Both reviewers approved correcting the registered matrix counts to 39 invalid and 9 valid while retaining 48 cases across eight six-case families.

Both reviewers approved REC-110-A03-v2: an aggregate-only grouped valid seed retains exactly one stale GROUP BY source-alias consumer after the declaration rename, so MQ3015_UnknownAlias is the bounded primary diagnostic.
The reviewers required the v1 contract and manifest to remain immutable and the replacement to be a versioned v2 contract, not an appended 49th case.

sourceJustification.revision1Observation: The valid v1 seed 'select a.Country, Count(*) from #A.entities() a group by a.Country' passed, but its mutated result emitted two Bind diagnostics: MQ3012_NonAggregateInSelect for Country and MQ3015_UnknownAlias for a.
sourceJustification.correction: Replace the v1 candidate with REC-110-A03-v2 using 'select Count(*) from #A.entities() a group by a.Country' and the same source-declaration rename to 'renamed', leaving 'group by a.Country' stale.
sourceJustification.reason: The aggregate-only projection removes the independent nonaggregate grouping condition without removing the required stale source-qualified consumer. The corrected query remains a valid grouped seed and the mutation has one declared fault at the GROUP BY boundary.

authority.passage: Aliases are query-block scoped; a renamed declaration leaves a stale source-qualified consumer unresolved as an unknown alias, while an aggregate-only grouped projection avoids an independent nonaggregate grouping error and dependent cascades.

sourceJustification.revision1Observation: The frozen v1 contract declared validationControlCount 12, invalidCandidates 36 and validOrdinaryCases 12, but the registered fixture contained 39 invalid and 9 valid candidates; the matrix assertion failed at the first incorrect count.
sourceJustification.correction: Revision 2 records validationControlCount 9, invalidCandidates 39 and validOrdinaryCases 9, retaining all 48 registered cases and all eight six-case families.
sourceJustification.reason: The correction reconciles the pre-registered contract with the existing fixture classifications. No candidate is deleted, weakened or reclassified to hide an engine result.

fixtureCorrections: Before candidate observation, corrected the test harness to treat SuggestedFixes as strings and to pass the nullable expected token only after the invalid-candidate branch.
After the v1 observation, replaced only the A03 candidate version with the reviewed aggregate-only seed and corrected the matrix count assertions to match the existing 39/9 registrations.
